R2B-grouse-walk-0001.name: By Inland Lake
R2B-grouse-walk-0001.pressureWhy: 3.6 km on foot from the nearest parking (estimate).

evidence.t: Trail: Sunshine Coast trail, 3.5 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
8 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
4 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: Route crosses provincial park: Inland Lake Park. Hunting only where that park allows it, in open season. Check its bcparks.ca page (synopsis page 9, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: sooty (blue), ruffed and spruce: 10 (30) in aggregate
No row in the Region 2 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from District of Squamish, about 127 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.91995, -124.48958, pull off on H22 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk 150 m to the start. Walk: the Sunshine Coast trail stretch, 3.5 km one way. About 70 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 2-12, Region 2. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
